name: input_takedamage
about: TakeDamage applies damage and, when lethal, kills. CAI_BaseNPCTroika's TakeDamage input 0x102c29a0 (FIELD_INTEGER) applies the amount with the wire's activator as attacker: OnTakeDamage_Alive 0x10265ed0 fires OnDamaged (+0x5e0c) and OnHalfHealth; a lethal amount runs Event_Killed 0x10265ad0, which fires OnDeath (+0x5e24). Param verbatim from hw_cemetery_1 (ss_zombie_1 '500'). sp_tutorial_1's Hunter1 (npc_VHumanCombatant, D_LI 0, use_interesting 0, dialogname dlg/generic/hunter1.dlg) verbatim, the player at the start, in its view.
